title: Time Needed to Rearrange a Binary String
summary: Given a binary string, replace all '01' with '10' simultaneously until no '01' remains, then return the number of seconds taken to complete the process.
statement: Given a binary string, replace all '01' with '10' simultaneously until no '01' remains, then return the number of seconds taken to complete the process.
constraints: Every second, replace all non-overlapping occurrences of 01 with 10 simultaneously.
Return the number of simultaneous rounds.
hints: Count zeroes encountered while scanning left to right.
A one with zeroes before it must move; it needs at least zeros seconds to cross them.
It also cannot finish earlier than one second after the preceding moving one, giving max(seconds+1, zeros).
This recurrence captures both independent lower bounds, and the simultaneous swaps achieve their maximum exactly.
editorial: This recurrence captures both independent lower bounds, and the simultaneous swaps achieve their maximum exactly.

tests.explanation: The strings progress through four simultaneous rounds before all ones precede all zeroes.
There is no 01 pair initially, so zero seconds are needed.
